name: Azgad
title: Head of a returning family
summary: Azgad was the ancestor of a family that returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His descendants are mentioned in several lists of those who returned with Zerubbabel and later with Ezra. His family was among the significant families that contributed to the rebuilding of the Jewish community after the exile.

keyEvents.title: The Return of Descendants with Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: 1,222 descendants of Azgad returned from Babylon to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel during the first return from exile.

keyEvents.title: Confirmation in Nehemiah's List
keyEvents.description: Azgad's family is also recorded in Nehemiah's list of those who returned, with 2,322 people mentioned.

keyEvents.title: Further Descendants Return with Ezra
keyEvents.description: During Ezra's return from Babylon, additional members of Azgad's family came, namely Johanan son of Hakkoz, along with 110 men.

keyEvents.title: Sealing the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Azgad is mentioned among the leaders who put their seal on the covenant to follow God's law during Nehemiah's time in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Rebuilt Community
keyEvents.description: Azgad's family was part of the larger community that worked to rebuild the temple and the walls of Jerusalem, committing themselves to live by God's commands.
